changelog: **Self-serve API keys for SOURCE owners (#2006):** the company model applied to a referring source — `ApiKey.sourceId`, `SOURCE_KEY_SCOPE_CEILING = ['candidates:read']` (`src/lib/sourceApiKeyRule.ts`; above it is `403 scope_above_ceiling`), `withApiKey(…, { sourceScoped: true })` + `sourceOnly(key)` on `GET /api/v1/candidates` (list and item) and `/me`, every other route answering `403 source_key_not_allowed`. `POST/GET/DELETE /api/source/integrations/api-keys` (`ownSource()`, `403 source_not_assigned`, warning-level audit, demo blocklist) and a `/source/integrations` page; the company page's key screen is now the shared `OwnerApiKeys` component. The admin key list shows the owning source. Pinned by `e2e/source-api-keys.spec.ts` (@smoke).

en: Referring organisations can now create their own API keys under API keys, to read the candidates they referred — and only those.
tr: Yönlendiren kurumlar artık API anahtarları ekranından kendi anahtarlarını oluşturup yalnızca kendi yönlendirdikleri adayları okuyabiliyor.
de: Vermittelnde Organisationen können jetzt unter API-Schlüssel eigene Schlüssel erstellen, um die von ihnen vermittelten Kandidat:innen zu lesen – und nur diese.
